summary: Regression retest of md:hidden fix on /jkhive/shifts ShiftMgmt page. The previous iteration found that on desktop the mobile day-card list rendered alongside ShiftGrid because inline display:flex overrode Tailwind md:hidden. Fix wraps the inline-flex container in an outer <div className='md:hidden'>. Verified at viewports 1280, 1024, 768, 767, and 390 px after logging in as admin@jollys.com and picking Timperley. Fix works correctly: at >=768px only shifts-grid is visible and shifts-day-* cards are hidden via the outer wrapper (display:none on the md:hidden parent). At <768px the grid wrapper is hidden and the seven shifts-day-* cards render normally along with mobile controls.
critical_code_review_comments: Fix is correct but slightly defensive: outer wrapper sets className conditionally (isAdmin ? 'md:hidden' : ''). When not admin the outer div is empty/no-op, which is fine. The inner div still has inline display:flex — preserving that as inline style is acceptable since visibility is now controlled at the outer wrapper. Consider migrating the inline flex/gap/flexDirection to Tailwind utility classes long-term to reduce style/className duplication, but not blocking.

context_for_next_testing_agent: md:hidden regression on ShiftMgmt page is FIXED and verified at multiple viewports (1280, 1024, 768, 767, 390). DOM probe at desktop confirms day cards' parent chain contains a div with class='md:hidden' and computedStyle display='none'. The shifts-grid itself stays display:block but is wrapped in 'hidden md:block' so it is effectively hidden on mobile (parent display:none, gridWidth=0 at 390px). NOTE: the date-nav testids are shifts-prev-week / shifts-this-week / shifts-next-week (NOT shifts-prev / shifts-next / shifts-today). Update future scripts accordingly. End-to-end flows (quick-add, click-to-edit, drag-and-drop, mobile controls) were intentionally NOT retested — they already passed in iteration_30.
rca of the issue: Original bug: inline style display:flex won over Tailwind's md:hidden (which sets display:none via class selector). Inline styles have higher specificity than any class-based rule. Fix in /app/frontend/src/pages/jkhive/ShiftMgmt.jsx ~line 312 wraps the inline-styled flex container inside <div className={isAdmin ? 'md:hidden' : ''}>. Because the OUTER element has only a className and no inline display, Tailwind's md:hidden takes effect at >=768px, hiding the entire subtree including the inline-flex child. Verified via window.getComputedStyle on the parent chain at 1280px: outer wrapper {tag:'DIV', cls:'md:hidden', display:'none'}.
